text_block_list.text:
Мэдзиро Райан has been training late into
the
evenings in preparation for the
Satsuki Sho.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
On one such occasion, she encounters
Ines Fujin,
who is also still practicing.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ines vows to grab Ryan's attention, as
Ryan is
focused solely on beating Mejiro
McQueen in
their next race.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
As a result, Мэдзиро Райан begins to feel
anxious
about competing against her
friend.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
